title: {{NAME}} and the Robot Who Found Magic
moral: Magic is all around us when we open our eyes and our hearts.

pages.content: {{NAME}} and his small robot friend walked into the Shimmer Forest. The robot was called Clank. Clank had never seen a forest before. He kept looking all around. The trees glowed softly in pink and gold. Clank made a curious beep.

pages.content: Clank stopped walking. He said, "What is that?" A beautiful unicorn stepped out from behind the trees. It was white with a golden horn. It looked right at Clank. Clank's little green light on his chest blinked fast. He was amazed.

pages.content: The forest filled with music and light. Other small animals came to watch. Clank danced with the unicorn. Then Clank stopped and looked at {{NAME}}. "Magic is real," Clank said softly. {{NAME}} nodded. "It really is," he said.
